title: The Mountain Gets the Dark Sky
skyStory: New moon in Capricorn. The moon has gone completely dark, and of all the rooms in the sky it chose Nancy's, which is either a compliment or a very long sleepover. Saturn, Capricorn's ruler, has tidied the guest room, folded the towels into tiny mountains, and left a ruby on the pillow. Seeds planted tonight grow slowly and never quit.

reading: The moon is staying at Nancy's place this week, which means your job is to be a very good neighbour. Shovel the metaphorical walkway. Carry over the metaphorical casserole. In plain terms: send her one message today that asks for nothing and gives a little something.

In your own world, the dark moon wants you to plant one idea and then leave it alone. This is hard for a Fire Tiger. You like to dig seeds up to check on them. Write the idea on paper, tuck it under the onyx bracelet overnight, and do not look at it again until the full moon on the twenty-second.
joel.mission: Write one idea on paper, tuck it under your onyx overnight, and promise not to reread it until January 22.
joel.omen: A single light left on in a dark house down the road. It means someone is thinking of you kindly tonight.

reading: The moon has come home to Capricorn, and the sky has rolled out a dark velvet carpet in your honour. Saturn bows. You get to set intentions tonight with home-field advantage, which means whatever you plant now roots deep. Choose carefully, but do not overthink it.

The [[Six of Swords]] is quiet today, the boat resting at the dock. The crossing is still happening, but tonight you get to sit on the bench and look at the stars. Write three intentions: one practical, one generous, one totally silly. The silly one matters most. Saturn needs to learn to laugh.
nancy.mission: Write three intentions tonight: one practical, one generous, and one completely ridiculous.
nancy.omen: A star you can see from your window between 8 and 9 pm. Pick it. It is yours for the year.

together.text: Both of you step outside for sixty seconds after dark and look at the spot where the moon would be. You will see nothing. That is the point. Say one wish into the dark at the same moment, by text countdown. The new moon keeps excellent secrets.
